scope: Four small right-gripper encoder-displacement tests with staged damped stops at one pose, two in each direction. Not jaw-travel/force or whole-arm qualification.

validation.cross_build: three AArch64 ELF64 binaries; finite-trial binary staged and exercised on hardware

limits_of_evidence: All four trials met unchanged envelope and settling criteria. This does not establish reliability over the workspace, larger jaw travel, load or exact stopping time.

Raw motor feedback reports small encoder displacement, much of which relaxes on drive removal. Independent confirmation of jaw travel is still needed; command at the 0.003 rad threshold is not an independently measured breakaway torque.
Last acknowledged Reset is disabled drive, not a guarantee of zero velocity. All final samples remained below the 0.2 rad/s envelope; all 14 motors were subsequently verified in Reset without faults.
Prior immediate-stop failure remains historical evidence. No firmware/flash writes, persistent limit changes, legacy service enable, CAD calibration or arm movement was performed.
